_doc: ATTACK_HIGH's raise, committed ~30% into the slam (captured.start), then a late, quick pull back to rest (captured.end). The recipe only has 4 keys (rest, raise, cock, pull-back), so 'following the slam' is done by aiming the raise at a pose 30% along the cocked->slam-end line; the pull back is as quick as the elbow's 300 deg/s cap allows to REST. In a chain the pull-back key is pinned at 1.0 s, so shorter t_back = pull back starts later. pull_back offsets only apply when captured.end is removed.

_help.like: uses this attack's raise and cock, then snaps back
_help.pull_back.lift: shoulder offset from the raised pose for the snap back (deg; negative = pulls back/up)
_help.pull_back.wrist: wrist offset for the snap back (deg)
_help.t_back: seconds: the snap back (0.38 = the fastest that keeps the elbow under 300 deg/s on the way to rest; 0.35 hit 316)
_help.captured.start: raised/cocked pose (real degrees): ATTACK_HIGH's cocked pose moved 30% toward its slam end, so the feint commits into the slam line before pulling back (40% brought the blade within 2.0 cm of an opponent resting blade as the jaw closes on the pull-back). Delete to use the attack's exact cocked pose.
_help.captured.end: end pose captured from the arm 2026-09-12 (real degrees): the rest pose (lift clamped from -89.7 to the -89 hard rule). Overrides pull_back. Delete the entry to go back to the computed pose.
